name: Nicole Bassett

bio.statement: The Oregon Capital Chronicle voter guide describes Bassett as a business owner and sustainability leader who previously worked for Patagonia.
bio.excerpt: business owner and sustainability leader who previously worked for Patagonia

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Bassett lists her occupation as small business owner, and co-founder and CEO of The Renewal Workshop in Cascade Locks.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Small business owner Occupational Background: Co-Founder and CEO, The Renewal Workshop, Cascade Locks

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

bio.statement: Bassett lists York University and Simon Fraser University as her educational background.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: York University, Simon Fraser University.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: In the Oregon Capital Chronicle 2026 voter guide, Bassett lists legislation bringing economic opportunity to District 26 among her top priorities.
positions.excerpt: First, I want to pass legislation that brings economic opportunity to District 26 that reflects our communities' needs.

positions.statement: In the voter guide, Bassett says the work is to keep building on housing investments and remove barriers that slow development.
positions.excerpt: The work is to keep building on those investments and remove the barriers that slow development down.

positions.statement: In the voter guide, Bassett supports a road usage charge, paying by the mile rather than the gallon.
positions.excerpt: paying by the mile rather than the gallon, which is fairer and more sustainable long term.

positions.statement: In the voter guide, Bassett says that when people cannot see a doctor regularly, small problems become expensive emergencies.
positions.excerpt: When people can't see a doctor regularly, small problems become expensive emergencies.

positions.statement: Bassett says she will take on corporate consolidation and policies that raise the cost of rent and essentials, and defend against big tech overreach.
positions.excerpt: I’ll take on corporate consolidation and policies that drive up the cost of rent and essentials and defend against big tech overreach.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Bassett says she will work for affordable, accessible healthcare, protect reproductive healthcare access and oppose cuts that threaten rural hospitals.
positions.excerpt: I’ll collaborate to create more affordable and accessible healthcare options, protect access to reproductive healthcare, and oppose cuts that threaten our rural hospitals.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Bassett says she will support more funding for career and technical education, smaller class sizes and more mental health support in schools.
positions.excerpt: I’ll support increased funding for career and technical education, smaller class sizes, and more mental health support

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Bassett says she will prioritize wildfire prevention, support first responders and invest in solutions that keep people, land and homes safe.
positions.excerpt: I’ll prioritize wildfire prevention, support first responders, and invest in proven solutions that keep people, land, and homes safe.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 44

gaps: No education or taxes position found outside the pamphlet
